en.t: “It is not that easy, you know...”

units.source_text: 女人的呼吸合着挥铲的动作，毫不在意地说，

en.t: The woman spoke casually, her breathing keeping time with the motion of swinging the shovel,

units.source_text: “村子能有今天，都是我们这样拼命清沙的结果哟……

en.t: “The only reason the village has lasted until today is that we clear away the sand like this with all our might...

units.source_text: 真的，假如我们都置之不理的话，

en.t: Really, if we all just left it alone,

units.source_text: 那么，不出十天这村子就会给全部埋掉喽……

en.t: then in less than ten days this village would be completely buried...

units.source_text: 接着，嗨，我们一样绕到背后，把工作轮下去……”

en.t: Then, well, we go around to the back the same way and keep passing the work along...”
